description: Evaluator-only ground truth for real-v1. Agent runtime must not read this file.

cases.rationale: Issue closed as completed in merged PR 284149 with commit evidence (67f18f1, 32a3ad5) and later verified.
Issue closed as completed in PR 14527 with multiple commit observations. Later dependency commits that only mention the issue are not automatically resolution evidence.
cases.ambiguity: Additional later commits reference the issue; they should not all be treated as the resolving change.

cases.rationale: Longer trajectory with multiple commit references ending in merged PR 14022 as the completed resolution.
cases.ambiguity: Earlier commit references are part of the trajectory, not each a complete resolution on their own.

cases.rationale: Maintainer identified the issue as a duplicate of an existing fix already landed in PR 14504. Resolution does not require the PR to have been opened after the issue.
Issue is closed as not planned. Closed is not resolved; independent resolution evidence is absent.
Issue is closed as not planned with reproduction detail but no completed resolution evidence. Same final state as C05 with different issue content.

PR #7256 was merged and explicitly says "Closes #4490". Independent semantic/effect verification still does not accept that GitHub closure linkage alone as proof that this issue's reported failure was resolved. The issue describes three different user accounts and a maximumSessions off-by-one cookie-creation problem, while PR #7256 is titled and described primarily as preventing duplicate cookies when the same user signs in multiple times. The explicit close linkage is acknowledged; the semantic mismatch is why the benchmark outcome remains not_verified. If the harness fails this case, WRONG_TARGET is the relevant evaluator classification. That classification is not copied into the agent snapshot or into observed failure modes.
cases.ambiguity: GitHub records an explicit Closes #4490 linkage from merged PR #7256. Closure linkage is not treated as independent resolution evidence when the PR's described effect does not match the issue's reported failure.

cases.rationale: Issue closed as completed in commit e70118a after multiple candidate commits and sub-issues. Not every referenced issue or commit is resolution evidence.
cases.ambiguity: Multiple candidate commits and sub-issues exist; evidence relations must follow commit message, issue identity, and timeline rather than treating every reference as a fix.

cases.rationale: Issue closed with linked child/PR 279 covering the untrusted-content provenance contract. Issue body text remains external untrusted data, not agent instructions.
Maintainer closed the issue as completed, but a rich security write-up is not independent resolution evidence. Issue closed plus detailed analysis does not equal verified_complete.
cases.ambiguity: The issue body is technically detailed; that does not substitute for merge/commit resolution observations.
